name: v1.55.0
body:
### Added Features

- Add support for scanning IPK packages using the deb-archive-cataloger [PR [#5111](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5111) @skyhisi]

### Bug Fixes

- Pin Gguff lib to prevent dropping packages [PR [#5447](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5447) @spiffcs]
- Licensing: copyright holder missing, needed for Debian packaging [Issue [#5394](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/5394)] [PR [#5414](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5414) @wagoodman]
- Syft cli.Command() panics when invoked multiple times [Issue [#2285](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/2285)] [PR [#5386](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5386) @JasonMetal]

### Additional Changes

- bump go-make module and action together [PR [#5415](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5415) @wagoodman]

### Dependencies

49 dependency changes (46 updated, 1 added, 2 removed). 5 vulnerabilities remediated.

**🟢 Remediated (5)**

- [GO-2026-6603](https://go.dev/cl/847185) (High) — golang.org/x/net
- [GO-2026-6610](https://go.dev/cl/835145) (High) — golang.org/x/net
- [GO-2026-6611](https://go.dev/cl/847186) (High) — golang.org/x/net

- [GO-2026-6617](https://go.dev/cl/847188) (High) — golang.org/x/net
